initial.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production transparent sprite sheet for the existing desktop mascot. Input image is CHARACTER IDENTITY reference only. Preserve exactly green rounded robot head, blue circular glasses, blue single antenna, navy business suit, cyan tie, tiny yellow lapel pin, VERY SHORT stubby legs, black shoes, small green mitten hands, thick clean navy outlines and flat cel colors. Generate ONE 4-column by 4-row sprite sheet, 16 evenly spaced square cells, transparent background. Full body in each cell with generous padding, consistent head size across all cells. Character faces RIGHT in all poses, slight three-quarter view so glasses visible. No floor, no wall, no platform, no letters, no motion trails or detached dots. Implied contact surface is on character's RIGHT, do not draw it. Row1 four looping climbing poses: right hand high left knee tucked; left hand reaching higher right foot braces; left hand high right knee tucked; right hand reaching higher left foot braces. Distinct alternating hand and foot placements, short legs never elongate. Row2 ledge pull-up sequence: both hands gripping imaginary ledge above shoulder level body dangling; elbows bend lifting body; chest passes ledge with one tiny knee raised; stand upright proudly after climbing. Row3 travel jump sequence: deeply crouch knees before launch; push off leaning right hands forward; airborne body tucked with short bent legs; landing squat arms forward. Row4 hanging recovery sequence: one hand grips imaginary ledge at upper right with dangling short feet; both hands grip and swing body slightly; braces one foot against invisible wall; stable two-hand hang ready to climb. Polished consistent character matching reference, absolutely no long legs, no duplicated limbs. Output high resolution clean alpha PNG.

final.prompt: Edit the attached 4x4 transparent sprite sheet. Preserve the character identity, all head sizes, colors, short legs, suit, glasses, antenna and clean dark outline, preserve rows 2,3,4 exactly. ONLY FIX ROW 1: four real wall-climbing keyframes, facing RIGHT. Both hands must be reaching toward an invisible vertical wall to the right, NOT one hand held at the chest. Show a clear alternating hand-over-hand climbing cycle: frame 1 near hand grips high, far hand grips lower, near foot low and far knee raised to wall. Frame 2 far arm extends upward past near hand while near elbow bends, near knee begins lifting. Frame 3 far hand grips high, near hand grips lower, near knee raised and far foot low. Frame 4 near arm extends upward past far hand, far knee begins lifting, returning toward frame 1. Use 3/4 side view, retain two blue eyeglass lenses and antenna. Stubby tiny legs must stay short and knees bend, no stretched limbs. Both hands visibly placed at two different heights on the RIGHT of head/body. Keep arms connected to shoulders and show exactly 2 arms and 2 legs. Do NOT draw any wall/platform, text, numbers, guides, effects, or background. Keep exact evenly spaced 4 columns 4 rows layout, clean transparent background.
